Edit layout rebuilt: every flow

One panel on the right, the same as the Farm view's: what you are on, what is inside, then the actions, with Delete alone at the end. Every step is a page in that panel with Cancel and the next step at the bottom. The map is only for placing: the panel steps aside and a guide names the task. The camera keeps the same margins, so opening a page never moves it. Beside a narrow chat the panel becomes a bottom sheet.
